goal: Research a web-novel niche market and deliver a verifiable 1500-character report

nodes.title: Search public sources
nodes.brief: Search 5 public platforms for works, rankings and discussions about the target market; return only URL, title and platform
acceptance: Each entry includes platform and title
Do not fetch the full text

nodes.title: Write the report
nodes.brief: Using n1's sources, write a 1500±15% Chinese-character market report with at least 3 competitor comparisons
acceptance: Every fact carries a source id

nodes.title: Independent verification
nodes.brief: Check each of n2's factual claims against the sources without reading the writer's reasoning; output only the verdict
acceptance: Each claim has source_id, quote and verdict
